cards.subtitle: Deterministic Omnichannel Multi-Aspect-Ratio Ad Adaptation pipeline evaluation (preserving 100% of hero SKU/talent bounding boxes via SAM-2 saliency detection, extending canvas margins with Flux Fill / Wan 2.2 Outpainting, and dynamically reflowing Remotion price/subtitle HUDs outside TikTok/Reels/Xiaohongshu UI dead zones so amortized per-channel cost c_aspect(u) = c_0 / (1 + u) reaches 0.5000 at u = 1.0, locking C_active / C_aspect = 1.0000x across all 17 channel profiles u in [0.000, 1.000] with 0/17 violated) versus naive center-crop & fixed overlay positioning (which chops off 68% of widescreen canvas area and buries subtitles under platform buttons, inflating manual designer re-layout cost by 1 + u to 1.2500x at P4, 1.5000x at P8, and 2.0000x at P16 across 16/17 profiles) and 64-grid safe-zone quadrature.
